verses.verse:
षट्छिद्रासु बंशीषु शुद्धाः सप्त्स्वरा मताः।
सप्त छिद्रासु बंशीषु निषादौ द्वौ प्रकल्पितौ।४२।
verses.text: In six-holed flutes the seven śuddha notes are set; in seven-holed flutes two Niṣādas are provided.

commentary.text: That is, in flutes that have 6 holes only the śuddha (natural) notes are placed. The remaining notes come out sādhanādhīna (by skill, by opening a hole halfway). But in the seven-hole flute separate holes are made for both forms of Niṣāda, komal and śuddha.
